visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long black hair, wearing an orange bikini, stands in a clear turquoise pool at the base of a massive, multi-tiered waterfall surrounded by dense tropical greenery. She stretches her arms upward toward the sky. White text overlays the center of the frame against the mist. (2) The scene cuts to the same woman outdoors in a white dress and pearl necklace, holding a selfie stick and cheering excitedly. Palm trees and a swimming pool are visible in the background under a bright, cloudy sky. Gold dollar sign icons float around her head. (3) Transition to an indoor hall where dozens of people sit on the floor, looking toward a man standing in a white t-shirt. The lighting is bright and flat. Large yellow text appears. (4) An aerial shot shows an airplane wing and engine flying over a vast blue ocean dotted with small green islands. (5) The woman stands on a grassy mountain ridge, holding a Philippines flag. She wears black leggings and a sports top. Rolling hills extend into the distance. (6) Close-up of a hand writing in a lined notebook with detailed grammar notes. Then, a series of shots show the woman in a classroom setting, engaging in one-on-one lessons with different teachers across a desk. (7) Montage of school facilities: a pool with the logo 'I.BREEZE', a fitness gym, and people dancing outdoors at night. Map graphics highlight the locations of Baguio and Cebu. (8) Interior of a school cafeteria with long wooden tables and a buffet counter featuring various Asian dishes. The woman is shown eating a bite of food and gesturing with a thumbs-up. (9) A simple dorm room is shown with a single bed and wooden furniture. Then, the woman stands by a table full of snacks and medical kits next to a logo for 'iOutback'. (10) The woman speaks into a microphone on a stage in front of a seated audience. Final rapid cuts show the waterfall, mountain vistas, a crowded nightclub with neon lights, and a school of fish underwater.
